A working collection: many-body theory derivations, implementation notes,
notebooks with the code and the plots that came out of them. Written mostly for
my future self — public in case it helps someone else.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## How this is organised

Each note is a folder under `notes/`. Long derivations are also available as
PDF; notebooks can be downloaded and re-run. Filter by category above.
:::
